scrollWindow.note: start = section top − viewport, end = section bottom − viewport (scroller scroll space)

trackedEls.why: THE sticky viewport (position:sticky top:0 — holds the entire composition)
intel overlay layer #1 (carries one display headline)
intel overlay layer #2 (carries one display headline)

meta.statePickNote: states are picked SEMANTICALLY from the coarse-probe timeline (per-stage method recorded in each state) then captured PURE FORWARD from scroll 0 — the load/reset class states are recorded apart because the .expanded layout toggle is direction-sensitive (reverse-scrolling the scrub re-flips it)
meta.probeNote: compositionProbe rows: [x, viewportY, w, h, opacity, translateY, scale] per tracked element; txt rows: [chars, 8-hex non-reversible fingerprint]; watch rows: {cls, w, x} per watched element
meta.thNote: "th" values are djb2 fingerprints of text content — used ONLY to detect/count distinct strings; content itself is never recorded

composition.note: ratio = ΔviewportY/Δscroll per probe step; locked = |ratio|<0.18 while element height>60px

introCard.note: bottom-left of the sticky frame; bottom-anchored (grows upward while items show); watch .active + item opacities in compositionProbe

states.method: fallback: interpolated (stage cue unresolved at this bp)

triggers.note: scrub rows re-measured post-scroll (pristine pass had stale 0 start/end for the map pair); toggle rows are the pristine pass
